description:
Goal. ADW gates German prose with the same depth it gates English prose today. The user asked for this on 2026-09-30.

Sources.
1. The Duden skill `duden-rechtschreibung` in ~/Development/skills-agents/skills/duden-rechtschreibung. It summarizes Duden "Einfach können" (Cornelsen 2025) with core rules and a chapter on AI writing traps in German.
2. The Duden online at duden.de.
3. The humanizer-de plugin 5.28.1 (MIT, Martin Moeller). It ships pattern references and lint scripts, among them german_pattern_lint.py, register_lint.py, and rhythm_lint.py.

Status. Open questions go to a grilling session first. The ticket gets split into sub-tickets after the user answers them.
title: Implement multi-lingual prose discipline, German first
